title: Ranch Water | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
meta_description: Ranch Water — a house in Watercolor, Florida. 14 guests · 5 bedrooms · 5.5 bathrooms. Book direct with Stay on 30a.
description_expanded: Welcome to 'Ranch Water' your private luxury escape in the heart of WaterColor along 30A, where relaxed coastal living meets elevated design.This stunning 5-bedroom, 5.5-bath retreat was thoughtfully designed for unforgettable beach vacations, featuring a private pool, expansive indoor-outdoor living spaces, and a separate carriage house with the 5th bedroom is perfect for guests wanting extra privacy. The home also features a bunk room, creating the perfect space for kids to unwind after long beach days and making this home ideal for multiple families or larger groups. Backing directly up to 30A, you’re just moments away from the very best of the Emerald Coast.Inside, you’ll find bright open-concept living spaces filled with natural light and comfortable gathering areas perfect for entertaining or relaxing after a day at the beach. The fully stocked kitchen flows seamlessly into spacious dining and living areas, creating the perfect setting for slow mornings, family dinners, and memorable nights together. Each bedroom offers a peaceful and private retreat for every guest after sun-soaked days along 30A.Step outside and discover your own private oasis. Spend your days lounging beside the sparkling pool, grilling and dining under the stars, or relaxing on the oversized porches with the warm Gulf breeze drifting through the palms.To make exploring WaterColor and 30A even easier, the home also includes 6 adult bikes, perfect for morning coffee runs, beach rides, and sunset cruises along the scenic bike paths.As a guest of 'Ranch Water,' you’ll also enjoy access to WaterColor’s coveted resort-style amenities, including community pools, beach access, scenic biking and walking trails, parks, and fitness facilities all adding to the unmatched experience of staying in one of 30A’s most sought-after communities.Perfectly located near sugar-white sands, turquoise waters, award-winning dining, boutique shopping, and endless coastal adventures, this one-of-a-kind home was designed to make every moment feel effortless, luxurious, and unforgettable.ACCOMMODATIONSRanch Water Sleeps: 14FIRST FLOORFull Bathroom-Kitchen-Living-Dining-LaundryBedroom #1: KingSECOND FLOORBedroom #2: King with EnsuiteBedroom #3: King with EnsuiteBedroom #4: Queen/Queen Bunk with Double Size Trundle + EnsuiteCARRIAGE HOUSEBedroom #5: QueenFull BathroomKitchenetteGARAGEHalf Bathroom-Second Laundry RoomHOME HIGHLIGHTSWaterColor Beach Club & Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum Allotted Wristband Qty is 14)Carriage House6 Adult BikesPrivate Pool *Pool Heat $50/DayFully Equipped Gourmet KitchenSmart TVsFull Sized Washer & DryerOutdoor FireplaceBeach Essentials5 Minute Walk to Watercolor Beach Club5 Minute Walk to Camp WaterColorPickle Ball & Tennis CourtsClose to Grayton state Park & Access to the Coastal Dune Lakes (Great for Kayaking & Yolo Boarding) Access to Beachside, Poolside and Lakeside DiningEasy Access to Parks & Walking PathsNearby State Parks & PreservesParking for 3 VehiclesPRIVATE BEACH & RESORT ACCESSThe WaterColor Beach Club is the only beachfront clubhouse pool available to rental guests along 30A. It is the ultimate amenity with three pools, expanded seating on upper and lower decks, and lounge areas. The Beach Club has several food and beverage options onsite, towel service, and a charming mercantile with sundries for your pool day. With unobstructed and panoramic views of the turquoise waters of the Gulf of Mexico, relaxation and pleasure await you at the Beach Club. Visit the WaterColor Beach Club page for facility hours, lounge chair etiquette, restaurant information, and rules. Wristbands must be worn by guests ages 5 and older. You can access the beach by walking through the Beach Club, and for those who want to sit on the sand, you can set up chairs and umbrellas behind the reserved chair area, or rent your own chairs and umbrellas from the rental shack.NEARBY PUBLIC BEACH ACCESSRay's Multi Mountain Beach Access: Is in the heart of Grayton Beach in "New Grayton", just to the west of the main Grayton Beach drive-on access at Hotz Avenue and the main "Grayton Dunes" access behind The Red Bar.Grayton Dunes Beach Access: Access is ADA accessible, has freshwater showers, and parking on the street. Located at the end of Garfield Street behind the Red Bar in the heart of Grayton Beach. The boardwalk also extends to the end of Banfill Street one block to the east. The access is next to Western Lake outfall and Grayton Beach State Park. The freshwater lake opens periodically and exchanges water with the gulf. Several fishing charters launch off the beach for half-day and full-day trips.WHAT WE OFFERA STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIESBody WashShampooConditionerHand SoapToilet PaperDish SoapDishwasher PodsLaundry DetergentPaper TowelsTrash BagsDish SpongeBath TowelsBed LinensPool TowelsWELCOME BUNDLECoffee Grounds2 Keurig PodsPopcornOlive OilFiji WaterPARKINGThree parking spaces available (3 driveway spaces). No street parking, driveway or gravel spaces only.Included are 6 bicycles (adult) for your convenience.GUEST ACCESSThe WaterColor community is the most desirable community on 30A due to its exceptional community amenities. Guests will have inclusive access to the gulf-front WaterColor Beach Club and new Camp WaterColor facilities, in addition to other beautiful swimming pools located throughout the community.The WaterColor Beach Club features a huge main pool and lounge area, an adults only pool, additional pool deck with even more lounge seating, and third pool area with zero-entry (perfect for even the littlest kids!). It also has dining service available, and a sunset bar, Costa Chica. All of these amenities have beautiful views of the Gulf!Camp WaterColor is geared towards kids and has its main butterfly pool with monarch slide for older kids, caterpillar pool (zero-entry + children's area with skipper slide for younger kids), lazy lizard pool (zero-entry + lazy river), lifeguards on duty, The Canteen restaurant + bar, basketball court, playing field, and playground.OTHER THINGS TO NOTEBeach chairs through WaterColor Beach Club should be reserved in advance.Per Watercolor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 14 wristbands max.In order to receive the proper number of amenity wristbands, you must enter the total number of people in your group upon booking, which you will receive a prompted email prior to your arrival. The HOA will not be able to provide additional wristbands once you are here.The WaterColor HOA will charge $50 per wristband to replace any that are lost. Watercolor requires guest contact information for Watercolor wristband registration a minimum of 1 week prior to arrival.Regarding the WaterColor pools, until water temperatures are consistently warm enough on their own, WaterColor's pools are maintained around 82 degrees.HOUSE RULES*Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM*Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.*This home is allotted 14 wristbands max per HOA.*No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.*No parties or events.*No street parking, driveway or gravel spaces only*During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues, no wifi, or slow wifi.*This home must remain pet free.IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVALAll guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie".Other things to note
